description:
COLD-REVIEWED DESIGN (2026-08-31), ready to build. One commit; docs ride it.

## The mechanism (pinned; recipes in earlier revisions' probes, all reverted)
analyze_activation claims ReturnType unconditionally; a no-evidence run's
first claim is minted as revision-1 CONTENT (was_absent => revision=1 in
facts.rs replace/extend_outputs), waking every Current reader of nothing.
Measured 00420 (fz2 interp debug @84ae179b4): 283 first-claims -- 135 EMPTY
/ 148 with content; 62 genuine in-place ascents; 302 quiet re-claims with
content; 299 quiet re-claims STILL EMPTY (separate mechanism: fz-kdt.85).
Direct wake count: 139 wakes caused by empty first claims (vs 160 by
contentful firsts, 239 by later bumps). Cross-fixture empties: 46/75
(range_map), 152/255 (predicate).

## The law (a kdt.63 corollary, not a new concept)
For a CUMULATIVE fact, absence and bottom are the same reading -- Current
readers provably cannot distinguish them (activation_return gates on
revision presence and returns None for both). So appearance-at-bottom is
presence, not content. Contrast: CallSiteSummary/Targets' bottom
(Unresolved) IS reader-visible content -- their first appearance stays a
movement. Replacing facts (Activation, Executable demand facts, the
absent-Activation gate) MUST keep first-appearance wakes -- the sibling red
test guards it.

## The three edits
1. facts.rs replace_outputs AND extend_outputs:
   was_absent => revision = u64::from(changed_listed || !key.is_cumulative())
   (F: ClaimShape bound on the FactTable impl; is_cumulative already means
   'this store maintains a join' -- a join has a bottom = the absent reading).
2. FactChange::content_changed => old.unwrap_or(0) != new.unwrap_or(0)
   (None<->Some(0) is not content either way; Some(n>0)->None still is).
3. Delete the now-false scheduler.rs:531 comment ('First appearance is news
   ... nothing read it' -- false: prepare_function_call reads absent
   ReturnType unconditionally). Docs: fact-engine.md 'Absence is bottom'
   gains the claims-layer corollary + revision-0 as representable
   present-at-bottom; semantic-fixpoint.md states claim=question live,
   revision=evidence moved, Settled+no-content=the Kleene never-returns fact
   (four consumers: artifact.rs:57 unwrap-to-none, transport.rs:281
   unreachable, :1372/:1488 bottom shapes).

## Red-first (engine altitude, scheduler_test's ClaimShape at :44)
(i) cumulative fact claimed with empty changed list: present, wakes NO
Current reader, still reaches Settled/SettledPresence waiters; (ii) first
CONTENT claim wakes the Current reader exactly once; (iii) SIBLING GUARD: a
replacing fact's unmarked first claim still wakes Current readers.

## Acceptance (recipes attached in-test)
- The 135/46/152 empty first-claims STILL OCCUR (claims unchanged; wakes
  removed): probe or derive from stream.
- Empty-claim wake count 139 -> 0 on 00420 (stream join on changed
  old_revision=null x wakes.cause).
- Zero-change evals 192/85/171 DOWN; ReturnType-attributed floor 71/43/37 --
  above the floor means census attribution was wrong = a finding.
- Green untouched: the never-returns settlement tests
  (compiler2_never_returning_function_settles_with_empty_evidence,
  compiler2_unproductive_deepening_settles_at_bottom_without_widening), the
  kdt.44 scheduler suite, unresolved re-emission quietness, both determinism
  tests; canon byte-compare on all three fixtures (byte-neutrality PROVED:
  the only revision reaching an artifact is BackendProgram's, non-cumulative);
  lib/fz2_cli/matrix full green; zero-uncaused unweakened.
- Re-pins same commit with attribution: zero-change/eval ratchets; any pin
  rendering movements[].revision (revision 0 becomes representable).

## Costed behavioral edge (measure; guard in-story if it shows)
First real content becomes Some(0)->Some(1): revision_bump true where
None->Some(1) was false -- shift differs only for a REBASED publisher's
first real evidence (conservative direction: more rebases never fewer). If
extra work appears, guard revision_bump with old.unwrap_or(0)==0 in the
SAME commit, never deferred.

## STOP conditions
- A Current WAITER on any cumulative fact surfaces (none exists today).
- The determinism pair goes red (wake ORDER must not move; this change only
  removes wakes).

## Killed options (do not re-walk)
(a) defer-the-claim: consumer sweep DIRTY -- the empty claim is the sole
carrier of settled-at-bottom/never-returns; absent facts can never settle
(is_locally_settled requires a publisher); deferral also weakens transitive
finality (absent reads are quiet -- a caller's cone could drain-settle while
the callee climbs) and trips retraction-by-omission (ReturnType isn't
preserved). (b) claimed-empty state: re-derives what publishers/revision
already encode; adds without deleting. FunctionContract analog CHECKED,
DOES NOT EXIST (100% first-claim-with-content; its 65/30/33 zero-change
causes are real movements re-running whole jobs -- fz-kdt.86).
title: Appearance at bottom is not a content movement: delete the was_absent revision mint for cumulative facts
